# Web On Dev

> Web On Dev is a professional software development company specializing in web development, mobile app development, UI/UX design, digital marketing, cloud & DevOps, and custom software solutions. Founded in 2015, headquartered in Lahore, Pakistan, serving clients worldwide.

## About

Web On Dev is a full-service software development agency providing end-to-end digital solutions. We transform business ideas into scalable web applications, mobile apps, and digital platforms using modern technologies like Next.js, React, React Native, Flutter, Node.js, Python, AWS, and Vercel.

- Website: https://www.webondev.com
- Founded: 2015
- Headquarters: Lahore, Pakistan
- Team Size: 11–50 professionals
- Service area: Worldwide (clients in the US, UK, Canada, Australia, UAE, and Pakistan)

## Q&A

### What does Web On Dev do?
Web On Dev is a software development agency based in Lahore, Pakistan that builds custom websites, web applications, mobile apps (iOS, Android, React Native, Flutter), and enterprise software. It also offers UI/UX design, e-commerce development (Shopify, WooCommerce), cloud & DevOps (AWS, Azure, GCP), and digital marketing, serving clients worldwide.

### What technologies does Web On Dev use?
Web On Dev builds with Next.js, React, React Native, Flutter, Node.js, and Python, and deploys on AWS, Azure, Google Cloud, and Vercel. For e-commerce it works with Shopify and WooCommerce.

### How much does a project cost at Web On Dev?
Typical ranges are: web development $3,000–$100,000+, mobile apps $10,000–$150,000+, UI/UX design $2,000–$25,000+, and digital marketing $500–$10,000/month. Final pricing depends on project scope; Web On Dev provides a free custom quote.

### Where is Web On Dev located and who does it serve?
Web On Dev is headquartered in Lahore, Punjab, Pakistan, and serves clients worldwide, including the United States, United Kingdom, Canada, Australia, the UAE, and Pakistan.
